baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated subjects in يسبح الرعد بحمده والملائكة من خيفته.
baseline_models.mechanism: Atmospheric motion and sound render praise while conscious heavenly agents render awe; the two clauses coordinate different media of creaturely alignment rather than merely personifying weather.

activation_trace.role: Swimming or running supplies sustained kinetic motion, making praise an enacted trajectory rather than speech alone.
Sky thunder and lightning supply the audible atmospheric body of that kinetic praise.
Praise opposed to blame gives the motion its evaluative and devotional orientation.
The angel branch anchors a conscious class of responders alongside the atmospheric responder.
Anticipatory fear supplies the angels' affective mode of alignment without equating it with thunder's sound.

changed_reading.before: Thunder and angels are two items in a list of worshippers.
changed_reading.after: The ayah coordinates sound, motion, praise, and awe as distinct media of one nonhuman liturgy.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The serial chain يرسل الصواعق فيصيب بها من يشاء and the closing شديد المحال.
baseline_models.mechanism: Sending, atmospheric impact, accurate arrival, selection, and overpowering capacity form a delivery-to-target chain; the bolt is not random spectacle inside the ayah's grammar.

activation_trace.role: Release and dispatch initiate a directed causal chain.
The upper-atmosphere crash supplies the dispatched event and its destructive intensity.
Aimed arrival at a target turns mere descent into successful contact.
Will attached to a thing supplies selection within the impact chain.
Strength, punishment, and prevailing force close the chain with capacity to overcome resistance.

changed_reading.before: A storm happens and someone happens to be struck.
changed_reading.after: The verbs stage a selected dispatch whose release, arrival, and overpowering consequence are causally linked.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Thunder's praise precedes وهم يجادلون في الله وهو شديد المحال.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah opposes two vocal fields: atmospheric warning ordered as praise and human argument tightened into an adversarial knot, already enclosed by a stronger counter-strategy.

activation_trace.role: Thunder used for threatening warning lets the storm sound function as admonitory address.
Tight twisting gives dispute a material shape as strands wound into a resistant knot.
Entangled contention anchors that knot in the explicit human disputation.
Binding and tightening intensify the contest immediately before the final predicate.
Counter-plot, maneuver, and contest supply an answering intelligence rather than raw force alone.

changed_reading.before: The weather report and the theological dispute are adjacent but independent.
changed_reading.after: Ordered thunder becomes warning speech that exposes human disputation as a knot inside a superior counter-move.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sequence places the focus storm inside governance, measure, visible lightning, opposed fear and hope, and deliberately formed heavy clouds. Fear therefore remains live but ceases to make the event univocally punitive.

activation_trace.role: The focus ayah's anticipatory fear anchors the affective side that context revises.
Planning with regard to consequences frames cosmic events as governed processes.
A measured limit supplies bounded calibration before the storm sequence.
The flash supplies the visible onset immediately preceding thunder's audible praise.
The same fear image extends the focus affect into the weather prelude.
Heartfelt hope keeps anticipated benefit co-present with danger.
Drawn cloud-mass gives the praise-and-strike scene a material carrier.
Weight gives the clouds stored consequence, whether beneficial release or damaging discharge.

structural_cues: The ordered run 13:8-13 moves from universal measure through visibility and protection to lightning, fear/hope, heavy clouds, thunder, and targeted impact.
The paired accusatives خوفا وطمعا resist reducing the weather display to a single affect.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies governance, measure, the fear/hope polarity, heavy clouds, and immediate sequence; the reader supplies the arrow from adjacency to one calibrated weather system. A live alternative is that the clauses are rhetorical signs without a shared physical mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Praise, angelic fear, and thunderbolt make a purely punitive storm tableau.
changed_reading.after: The focus ayah is the dangerous phase of a measured weather complex that carries hope and stored benefit as well as fear and impact.

context_deltas.mechanism: The true-call/unanswered-call contrast and the next ayah's willing-or-constrained prostration recast thunder's praise as effective response within universal submission; disputation becomes a failure of conscious response, not an exemption from creaturely submission.

activation_trace.role: Devotional praise anchors thunder as a responding worshipper.
Entangled contention anchors the human counter-response that the context diagnoses.
Calling by speech supplies the address to which a real or failed response can occur.
A returned answer distinguishes efficacious response from futile invocation.
Lowering in submission generalizes the responsive posture across heavens and earth.
Voluntary compliance supplies one mode of universal submission.
Being compelled into what is resisted supplies the other mode without erasing the polarity.

structural_cues: 13:14 contrasts the true call with an unanswered gesture toward water, then 13:15 universalizes prostration.
The polarity طوعا وكرها allows disputants to resist consciously while remaining within a larger compelled order.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies call/answer failure followed by universal willing-or-unwilling prostration; the reader treats thunder's praise as the successful-response side of that sequence. Alternatively, 13:14-15 may classify worship generally without commenting on thunder's sound.

changed_reading.before: Thunder's praise is an exceptional poetic animation of one natural object.
changed_reading.after: Thunder is an audible instance of universal response, while human disputation is the anomalous conscious refusal inside an order that still submits.

context_deltas.mechanism: The water-and-fire analogy supplies a sorting process: measured channels carry a turbulent mixture, heat raises analogous scum, the unstable passes, and benefit remains. This activates the focus strike as an exposing and separating event in addition to punishment.

activation_trace.role: The fiery upper-atmosphere crash anchors the focus event that the assay model re-reads.
Accurate impact supplies the decisive contact that can expose what a target contains.
Prevailing force supplies the pressure under which separation becomes visible.
Each channel's measure bounds what it can carry.
Flood-flow supplies transport through a measured material channel.
Floating foam supplies the exposed but non-enduring layer in both water and fire analogies.
Kindled fire supplies an assay parallel to the storm's fiery discharge.
Loss of truth and stability identifies what the process removes.
Remaining in place after waiting identifies the durable residue.

structural_cues: 13:17 explicitly pairs water-flow and fire-heating, repeats foam three times, and opposes يذهب to يمكث.
The focus ayah already combines atmospheric water potential, fiery discharge, accurate impact, and disputation before this sorting analogy appears.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two material separation processes and their truth/falsehood application; the reader extends that sorting arrow backward to the focus impact. The live alternative is that the bolt is punitive only and the later analogy is conceptually independent.

changed_reading.before: The selected bolt only destroys or penalizes its target.
changed_reading.after: Impact can also be carried as an assay image: force exposes unstable surface claims while what has weight and benefit persists.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reverent fear becomes accountable endurance and then threshold-crossing service: the same angel class that stands in fear in the focus later enters through every gate bearing safety. Fear is disciplined readiness, not paralysis or a terminal affect.

activation_trace.role: The explicit angels anchor identity across the two scenes.
Anticipation of harm supplies the focus affect whose function is revised.
Fear joined with reverent awe turns affect toward attentive accountability.
Repeated anticipatory fear links the angelic affect to human concern for reckoning.
Counting and account give fear an ordered object rather than diffuse panic.
Holding the self back from alarm supplies the discipline that carries awe through trial.
The reappearing angels anchor a later active role for the same class.
Entering inward supplies purposeful movement across a threshold.
Every entrance turns angelic action into distributed threshold service.
Safety and freedom from harm supply the message delivered by those fear-oriented agents.

structural_cues: 13:21-24 moves from awe and fear of account through patience to angels entering from every gate and speaking peace.
The repeated angel noun at 13:13 and 13:23 supports continuity of class without requiring identity of individual agents.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated fear vocabulary, patient restraint, repeated angels, gate-entry, and peace; the reader supplies the functional arrow from awe to reliable service. An alternative is that the two angel scenes show unrelated roles with no developmental relation.

changed_reading.before: The angels' fear is a static sign of overwhelming terror.
changed_reading.after: Their fear can be read as alert, accountable alignment that equips rather than prevents decisive service, ultimately compatible with delivering peace.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later remembrance settles hearts, so the focus pairing of praise and fear need not imply agitation. The storm's intensity can carry an ordered remembrance in which awe and stability coexist, set against the churn of dispute.

activation_trace.role: Devotional utterance anchors thunder's sound as remembrance-like praise.
Trembling and disturbance preserve the scene's high physical intensity.
Fear preserves awe, preventing calm from becoming affective flatness.
Entangled contention supplies the unstable human contrast.
Repeated stillness and reassurance supply the state generated around remembrance.
The heart gives that stability an inward human locus.
Remembrance running on the tongue supplies an audible practice that can settle rather than agitate.

structural_cues: 13:28 repeats both تطمئن and القلوب around repeated ذكر الله, making stabilization emphatic rather than incidental.
The focus ayah itself places ordered praise and angelic fear before human verbal entanglement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies audible remembrance and repeated heart-settling; the reader analogizes thunder's praise to that stabilizing sonic order. A live alternative is that human remembrance calms while thunder remains only externally terrifying.

changed_reading.before: Fear and thunder imply agitation, while calm would require the storm to cease.
changed_reading.after: Awe, vibration, and inward stability can coexist when powerful sound is ordered as praise; disputation, not intensity itself, is the destabilizing mode.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sending, recited revelation, imagined terrain-moving speech, and a calamity that keeps striking create a sound-to-consequence continuum. This activates thunder's praise and the bolt's hit as two consequence-bearing deliveries without identifying thunder with scripture.

activation_trace.role: Audible devotional action anchors meaningful storm sound.
Message and messenger potential lets dispatch carry communication as well as force.
Arrival at an intended target anchors consequence rather than sound alone.
The sent messenger makes communicative dispatch explicit later in the surah.
One sound following another materializes recitation as an ordered sonic sequence.
Divine news and inspiration identify what the recited sequence bears.
Reading and recitation anchor the hypothetical speech with physical consequences.
Motion and flowing supply the imagined displacement of mountains by recited speech.
A calamity befalling people repeats the focus impact root in an explicitly consequential setting.
A rebuke that strikes the hearer fuses auditory address with impact.

structural_cues: 13:30's sent-recitation sequence is followed immediately by 13:31's mountain-moving, earth-cutting, dead-addressing possibilities and recurring strikes.
The focus ayah likewise sequences meaningful sound, sending, impact, and resistant hearers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel send/recite/strike chains; the reader supplies a shared delivery-impact model. The alternative, and necessary caution, is that 13:31's counterfactual rhetoric does not make thunder a revelation or every strike a message.

changed_reading.before: Meteorological sound and recited revelation occupy unrelated channels.
changed_reading.after: They can coexist in a guarded model of consequential delivery: ordered sound bears address, while dispatched impact makes resisted consequence physically present.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence stretches severe محال from immediate storm-force into monitored counter-governance: earnings remain under watch, territory is reduced from its edges, judgment cannot be followed by a reversal, and account is swift. The focus counter-move can therefore unfold spatially and temporally, not only in one bolt.

activation_trace.role: Explicit contention anchors the resistance to which the larger governance model responds.
Concentrated strength supplies the intensity of the governing response.
Maneuver, counter-plot, and contest anchor strategic rather than merely explosive force.
Prevailing power and punishment ensure that the strategic reading retains coercive capacity.
Acquired action supplies the monitored human input to consequence.
Progressive loss of part supplies a spatially extended mode of pressure.
Edges and limits locate that pressure at a boundary rather than a single center.
Judgment between parties turns power into adjudication.
Absence of delay preserves the focus ayah's sudden force within the longer process.
Repeated acquisition ties final knowledge and outcome back to what each self produces.

structural_cues: The context lexeme مكر recurs at 13:33 and twice at 13:42, but its packet inventory lacks a citable plot branch; it is used here only as structural juxtaposition with the focus محال branch.
13:41 states that divine judgment has no معقب, grammatically blocking a later reversal, and pairs this with rapid account.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies monitored earnings, edgewise reduction, non-reversible judgment, rapid account, and an uncited structural repetition of مكر; the reader supplies the arrow from these processes to severe محال as comprehensive counter-governance. The live alternative is the narrower reading of محال as sheer immediate strength.

changed_reading.before: Severe محال names only the raw force displayed by an instantaneous bolt.
changed_reading.after: It can also name a strategic, adjudicative pressure that tracks action, works at boundaries, and culminates too quickly and firmly to reverse.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates drought and pulley branches where the surface clause names severe محال and never mentions water. It remains anchored in the focus storm, descent, dispatch, and محال inventories; downstream prose should present it only as a material systems analogy, never as the lexical translation of محال.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يرسل الصواعق فيصيب بها ... وهو شديد المحال as one atmospheric operating system.

activation_trace.role: Successive dispatched groups supply pulsed releases rather than one undifferentiated event.
The upper-atmosphere crash keeps the analogy attached to the actual storm event.
Rain descending from above supplies the downward water leg latent in the impact root.
Withheld rain and dried ground supply the system's deprivation state.
A large water-lifting pulley supplies the mechanical image linking lift, storage, and release.

changed_reading.before: The storm manifests only an externally directed punitive force.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it resembles a water-control apparatus whose agency can lift and release in pulses, or withhold until the land dries; destructive impact is one operating state among several.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a pejorative thunder branch is reflected onto the human disputants rather than assigned to literal thunder. It remains anchored by the ayah's immediate juxtaposition of praising thunder and argument; render it as ironic contrastive wordplay, not as a claim that الرعد denotes the humans.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The reversal between يسبح الرعد بحمده and وهم يجادلون.

activation_trace.role: Abundant useless talk supplies an ironic mirror for the nearby disputants, while literal thunder escapes the branch by praising.
Purification and exoneration make thunder's apparently inarticulate sound semantically clean.
Praise opposed to blame marks the storm's sound as valuable rather than empty.
Entangled contention identifies the human speech that inherits the empty-noise image.

changed_reading.before: Thunder is noise while human disputation is articulate reasoning.
changed_reading.after: The hierarchy reverses: thunder's sound is ordered and meaningful, while human argument risks becoming merely thunderous verbosity without benefit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapped root for ص و ب to activate an erected boundary marker. It remains formally anchored to the focus occurrence and visibly cooperates with bolt, dispute, and prevailing force; downstream prose must label it an exploratory image, not a gloss of يصيب.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فيصيب بها ... وهم يجادلون ... وهو شديد المحال.

activation_trace.role: The descending atmospheric crash supplies the event that leaves a mark.
An erected sign or boundary stone turns the hit into an installed visible limit in contested space.
Contention supplies the human crossing and recrossing that makes a boundary consequential.
Prevailing force enforces the limit rather than merely displaying it.

changed_reading.before: The impact terminates at a selected victim.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory secondary image, the impact also plants a limit: the bolt marks where disputation meets a boundary it cannot negotiate away.

strongest_changes: 13:12 revises a fear-only storm into a measured fear-and-hope weather complex.
13:14-15 turns thunder's praise from isolated personification into effective response within universal submission.
13:21-24 changes angelic fear from paralysis into accountable threshold service that can deliver peace.
13:17 activates an assay model, while 13:30-31 separately activates a guarded sound-message-impact continuum.
13:41-42 extends severe محال from an immediate blast to monitored, boundary-working, non-reversible governance.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supports simultaneous liturgical, causal, adversarial, material, and communicative readings. Especially diagnostic were the non-dominant ص و ب mapping, the ironic reversal in which thunder is meaningful and disputation noisy, and the drought/pulley images under محال; all remain contained rather than normalized into a single interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The sorting relation to 13:17 may be an abductive analogy rather than a causal explanation of the bolt.
The recitation-impact continuum does not establish that thunder is revelation; 13:31 may remain counterfactual rhetoric.
The context م ك ر inventory lacks a citable plot branch, so its repetition supports the counter-governance model structurally only.
The boundary-marker and hydraulic readings are intentionally form-distant and should remain exploratory.
